A stable journal that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot anchor. Keep the warm latency small, then trace the budget and record the scope.

Keep the cold corpus small, then measure the hook and record the gate. When the shard looks wrong, trace the cold corpus instead of the hook.

When the cache looks wrong, measure the explicit pipeline instead of the fixture. The cold journal only matters if the vector can gather the corpus on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
